title: Open Shorebird diversification profile, contract v3
description: Build input of a hardened-diversified native-release lineage (P5). bytecode.wire_opcodes[i] is the wire byte of public Dart bytecode opcode i (the PUBLIC_KERNEL_BYTECODES_LIST order of dart-sdk/runtime/vm/constants_kbc.h, whose names hash to opcode_table_sha256). It is a permutation of 0..N-1 with Trap kept at 0, derived from a private seed by scripts/diversification_profile.py. profile_id is sha256: over the canonical JSON of this document. native_layout is reserved and must be null in contract v3. See docs/HARDENING_CONTRACTS.md section 11. The permutation rules that JSON Schema cannot express are enforced by scripts/diversification_profile.py verify.
